perspective:
Bradley Ochoa’s available information:

- He is a salesperson at a marketing firm, and Katherine Lasiloo is the marketing manager and his colleague. He knows they have had differing views on sales vs. digital marketing and that their professional relationship has been cordial but sometimes strained.
- Bradley prepared data and charts from the last five campaigns to support traditional sales techniques. He believes traditional methods are being overlooked in favor of newer digital strategies that Katherine supports.
- In the meeting, Bradley told Katherine he appreciated her digital strategies but believed core sales could benefit more from traditional methods. He also said he was not suggesting they abandon digital marketing, but was frustrated that proven methods were being sidelined without proper consideration.
- He heard Katherine say the market is evolving, that digital outreach potential cannot be ignored, and that they should analyze the data together to integrate both approaches.
- After the meeting, Katherine shared recent digital campaign success stories that significantly boosted engagement and sales. Hearing this made Bradley uncertain and caused him to question his exclusive support for traditional methods.
- Bradley asked Katherine to explain more about how these digital strategies are developed. Katherine told him it is about targeting the right audience with the right message and offered to walk him through the analytics and decision-making process behind a recent campaign.
- Bradley admitted to Katherine that he had doubts about moving away from traditional methods, but the outcomes made him want to understand the digital approach more. Katherine said she was glad he was open to exploring it, that adapting to market trends matters, and suggested going deeper into the data.
- Bradley proposed a joint strategy meeting to combine traditional and digital approaches. Katherine agreed, said combining their strengths could lead to better results, and they planned to schedule a brainstorming/strategy session.
- Bradley said he was hopeful that leveraging both their expertise could create something impactful and appreciated Katherine’s willingness to collaborate. Katherine said she looked forward to leveraging each other’s strengths and making it happen.
- After the joint meeting, Bradley was excited and worked overtime to prepare a board presentation draft integrating both their ideas. He showed the draft to Katherine.
- Katherine reviewed it, praised it as comprehensive and well thought out, and said his hard work showed. Bradley thanked her, said he was convinced the integrated approach would set them apart from competitors, and wanted to make sure they nailed the presentation. Katherine agreed to go through it again and fine-tune areas as needed.
- After the presentation and implementation of the new strategy, Bradley felt grateful for his professional growth and successful collaboration with Katherine.
- Bradley thanked Katherine, said he had learned a lot from her, and proposed regular strategy sessions to continue their collaboration. Katherine agreed, saying regular sessions would keep them on top of their game and market trends, and they planned to do it.

Bradley does not have access to Katherine’s private thoughts, personality type, education, race, or any hidden events not stated, shared, or observed in these interactions.
